subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Analysing the Etihad Rail essay and collecting information / Planning and writing an informative essay; peer editing
outcomes: Analyse an informative essay about a rail safety campaign
Collect information and plan an informative essay
Write a first draft and edit a partner's draft

tf.s: The Etihad Rail essay has five paragraphs.
The campaign's message was to put safety first and respect the railway.
tf.why: Correct, that was the vital message.

tf.s: The Safety Bus travelled around Western Abu Dhabi.
tf.why: Yes, it shared information with communities there.

tf.s: People should cross the railway track anywhere they like.
tf.why: People should use bridges and underpasses.

tf.s: The campaign used a roadshow to share information.
tf.why: Right, the Safety Bus was a roadshow.

tf.s: You give your partner feedback using the editing checklist.
tf.why: Yes, the checklist guides your comments.

tf.s: Your informative essay does not need a title.
tf.why: Give your essay a suitable title.

tf.s: You attach the first draft to the second draft and give both to the teacher.
tf.why: Yes, the teacher can see your progress.

tf.s: Flyers are long books given only to engineers.
tf.why: Flyers are short printed sheets handed out to people.

tf.s: A supporting sentence introduces a completely new topic.
tf.why: A supporting sentence gives details about the topic sentence.

boxes.q: How can people cross the railway track safely?
boxes.why: Bridges and underpasses keep people safe.

o: A roadshow bus giving railway information
boxes.why: It travelled around to teach safety.
Flyers are handed out to people.
They warned people about railway safety.

boxes.q: What kind of essay do you write in this lesson?
boxes.why: You write facts about a type of transport.

o: Planned activities to keep people safe

boxes.q: What do you do after writing the first draft?
What do the Etihad Rail body paragraphs cover?
o: The Safety Bus, safety rules and flyers
boxes.why: Each paragraph covers one part of the campaign.

boxes.q: Which is a good topic sentence about trains?
o: Trains are a safe and efficient form of transport.
boxes.why: It is a complete sentence with a clear main idea.

hunt.q: Ways to cross over the track
A list used for peer editing

mcq.q: What was the vital message of the campaign?
o: Put safety first and respect the railway at all times

mcq.q: Why were underpasses built for animals?
o: So camels, gazelles and reptiles can cross safely
So animals can ride the train
To keep animals in one place

mcq.q: What should the five paragraphs of your essay be?
o: Introduction, three main body paragraphs, conclusion
mcq.why: This is the structure of an informative essay.

mcq.q: What do you check first in a partner's essay?
Choose a topic sentence for a paragraph about trains' economic benefits.
mcq.why: It states the main idea of the paragraph.

mcq.q: Choose: Trains are safe. ___, they are fast.
You want to write about buses. What should you do first?
o: Collect information about buses and plan your paragraphs

mcq.q: Why was a roadshow bus a good idea for the campaign?
o: It could travel to many communities and share information
It was faster than a train
mcq.why: A travelling show reaches many people.

mcq.q: Why should you attach your first draft to your second draft?
o: So the teacher can see how you improved
Because the second draft is shorter
Because the first draft is the final one

mcq.q: Why is safety important near railways?
o: Trains are fast and heavy and cannot stop quickly
mcq.why: That is why people must respect the railway.
